title: Jimmy Jerkens
text: James A. "Jimmy" Jerkens (born January 24, 1959 in Bay Shore, New York) is an American Thoroughbred horse trainer. His father, U.S. Racing Hall of Fame inductee H. Allen Jerkens, and brother, Steve Jerkens, are also trainers.

title: Respect to Mehmetçik Monument
text: The Respect to Mehmetçik Memorial (Turkish: "Mehmetçiğe Saygı Anıtı" ) is a monument in the Gallipoli peninsula, Turkey. Mehmetçik is a common name given to soldiers in a war, just like G.I..
